correctness.rationale: The even recurrence was independently reconstructed from Kiem's formulas, not accepted from a saved log. Palindromicity gives the exact reciprocal reduction \(P_n(x)=x^mQ_n(x+x^{-1})\) in even degree and the additional \(x+1\) factor in odd degree. The supplied rational endpoints have exact alternating \(Q_n\)-signs and lie left of \(-2\); degree counting therefore gives exactly one simple reduced root in each interval. An independent exact Sturm/root-count reconstruction through \(n=50\) confirmed that every reduced polynomial has its full degree of simple roots in \(( -\infty,-2)\). Each such root lifts to two distinct negative reciprocal roots, with the extra \(-1\) root in odd degree. The claim is explicitly finite and no extrapolation beyond 50 is made.
